summary: IceCure Medical Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing clinical data presentations at ECIO 2026 for its ProSense cryoablation system, including a near-90% recurrence-free rate in kidney cancer and positive breast/fibroadenoma outcomes. The filing is a routine disclosure of scientific conference results and corporate updates, not a special-situation transaction. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital event is described. There are no deal terms, strategic review, tender, or management change announced. The filing serves solely to disseminate clinical progress and regulatory/commercial momentum.
